problem: 'imixulu yemifino' is not a recognisable word for 'bundles' (use 'izithungu'); 'utamatisi uyabiza iR18' reads as a purchase price ('tomatoes are expensive at R18') rather than the R18/kg production cost the quiz relies on.
repaired:
Isivuno sinokondla indlu, sithengiswe, sabelwane ngaso, okanye silahleke.

Ukurekhoda ezi ndlela zahlukeneyo zokusetyenziswa kukunceda ubone ukuba ifama ivelisa ntoni nokuba yintoni efika kubathengi.

Sebenzisa loo lwazi ukukhusela ukutya kwendlu nokwenza izigqibo zorhwebo ezingcono.

Bhala phantsi sonke isivuno njengoko senzeka.

Rekhoda ii-kg zotamatisi, iidazini zamaqanda, nezithungu zemifino (morogo), uze uqaphele ukuba nganye iye phi.

Sebenzisa isiko elilula elifanayo kukutya okugcinwe ekhaya, kwemveliso ethengisiweyo, kweyaphiwe abanye, nekwenziwe umgquba.

Musa ukuthembela kwinkumbulo ekupheleni kwexesha lonyaka.

Iirekhodi zexesha elinye lonyaka ziphendula imibuzo esebenzayo.

Zeziphi izityalo ezinika isivuno esingcono kwibhedi nganye? Zeziphi ezibuyisa okuninzi kwiyure nganye yomsebenzi?

Zeziphi izityalo ezisebenzisa imbewu, amanzi nomgquba ongaphezulu kunokuba zibuyisa?

Irekhodi likwabonisa ukuba zeziphi iinyanga eziyishiya indlu ithenga ukutya.

Phambi kokumisa ixabiso, rekhoda iindleko zemveliso, zokupakisha nezokuthengisa, kuquka umsebenzi nothutho.

Nanku umzekelo wokufundisa, ayingoxabiso lemarike: iindleko zokuvelisa utamatisi ziyiR18 ngekhilogram nganye kodwa uthengiswa ngeR15 ngekhilogram nganye. Eli xabiso alizigubungeli iindleko ezichaziweyo.

Phonononga ixabiso, iindleko nokutyala okulandelayo. Jonga ukuba abathengi baza kuthenga ntoni ngokwenene; ixabiso eliphezulu lokucela asisiqinisekiso sentengiso.

Sebenzisa irekhodi lakho ukufumana ixesha apho ukutya kwendlu kuphela khona.

Khetha izityalo ezifanelekileyo apho uhlala khona, uze usebenze umva usuka kwisivuno oyidingayo. Jonga iimeko zokutyala nexesha elilindelekileyo lokuvuna.

Umhla osebenza kwenye ifama usenokungasebenzi apha. Quka isicwangciso sasemva xa imvula, amanzi okanye izityalo zisilela.

problem: Correct option uses a negative embedded question ('asinakubuyisa ngcono na' = 'whether another crop cannot return better'); English is positive 'would give a better return'. Make it positive so the right answer reads unambiguously.
repaired: Ixabiso lokuthengisa, iindleko, nokuba esinye isityalo singanika inzuzo engcono na
Iirekhodi zomfama zibonisa ukuba uswele imifuno rhoqo ngoJuni noJulayi. Liliphi inyathelo eliluncedo apha?

problem: NEGATION INVERTED: 'bengakwazi ukugcina isivumelwano' = 'CANNOT keep the agreement'; English says regular orders help planning only when customers and growers CAN keep the agreement.
repaired:
Buza ukuba umthengi ufuna ntoni: imveliso, ubuninzi, umgangatho, ukuhanjiswa nomhla wentlawulo.

Thelekisa iifizi zemarike, uthutho, ukupakisha neemveliso ezingathengiswanga kunye nexabiso lokuthengisa.

Jonga imithetho yemarike kunye neemfuno zasekuhlaleni zorhwebo nezokutya. Isitali esingekho sesikweni asiyonto ngokuzenzekelayo engenamithetho okanye iindleko.

Ukuthengisa ngqo kunokugcina inxalenye enkulu yexabiso lentengiso, kodwa kuthatha ixesha, ukupakisha, uthutho nokukhathalela abathengi.

Inkqubo yeebhokisi (box scheme) ibonelela ngokhetho oluqhelekileyo lweemveliso rhoqo kubathengi abavumelaneyo.

Vumelanani ngezinto eziya ebhokisini, ixabiso, intlawulo nento eyenzekayo xa izityalo zinqabile. Iiodolo eziqhelekileyo zinceda ukucwangcisa kuphela xa abathengi nabalimi bekwazi ukugcina isivumelwano.

Qala kwinto onokuyibonelela ngokuthembekileyo nakwinto abayifunayo abathengi.

Jonga iindleko nezidingo zokutya kwendlu phambi kokuthembisa iibhokisi eziqhelekileyo.

Ubungakanani begadi okanye inani labathengi kuphela alikuxeleli ingeniso. Zama ulungiselelo onokululawula uze urekhode iziphumo.

Ukuba imveliso iyatshintsha evekini ngeveki, phepha ukuthembisa ukuhanjiswa okungatshintshiyo ongenako ukukubonelela.

Nikela ngesivuno esigqithileyo onaso uze uvumelane ngemiqathango ecacileyo nabathengi.

Chaza iindlela zakho zokulima ngokunyanisekileyo. Jonga nasiphi na isatifikethi okanye isibango abasifunayo abathengi phambi kokusebenzisa ileyibhile.

problem: 'uthengisa le anayo' - dangling demonstrative 'le'; should be 'oko anako' (what she has).
repaired: Le yeyona ndlela engamfuni athembise isixa esimiselweyo veki nganye — uthengisa oko anako ngokwenene.

problem: 'zikuyo ngezantsi' puts the trowel and jar inside the box; English says they sit below it.
repaired: Iibhedi ezintlanu ezincinci ezityaliweyo kunye neentolo ezalatha kwibhokisi esembindini yemveliso; itrowula yesandla nejari yembewu zingezantsi kwayo.

problem: 'esiyisipheyo' is not an isiXhosa word (English: a spare legume plant); 'Latha' (point/direct) should be 'Gqiba' (decide); 'ngaphezu kwezikhewu' (above/more than the gaps) garbles 'across the spaces between fruit trees'; 'frequent severe cutting' lost 'severe'. Note: 'These bacteria' and 'It is indigenous to KwaZulu-Natal' lack antecedents in the English source too (text accompanying media) - source issue, not a translation error, but the native S. sesban vs invasive S. punicea distinction depends on it.
repaired:
Ezi bhaktheriya ziguqula i-nitrogen eseMoyeni ibe yiyo i-legume (isityalo esinembotyi emagobolondweni) enokuyisebenzisa.

Fumana ii-nodule (amaqhuma asengcambu) kwisityalo se-legume esongezelelweyo (esingadingekiyo). Ukwenza ii-nodule nokukhula kuxhomekeke kwisityalo, kwibhaktheriya efanelekileyo nakwiimeko zokukhula.

Buyisela iinqunqo zamagqabi ezifanelekileyo, amagqabi awileyo kunye neentsalela zezityalo njengengca yokugquma. Izidalwa eziphila emhlabeni zikhulula izondlo ngexesha lokubola.

Oku kuthatha ixesha. I-legume ephilayo ayiyombhobho womanyolo osebenza kwangoko ukuya emthini weziqhamo.

Imveli yaseKwaZulu-Natal. Kwiimeko ezifudumeleyo ezifanelekileyo, lawula esi sihlahla siphila ixesha elifutshane okanye umthi omncinci njengesityalo sokuxhasa.

Yiyekele indawo yokukhula. Yinqunqe ukuze ufumane ingca yokugquma uphinde uyihlole xa umthunzi okanye ukhuphiswano lwamanzi lunyuka.

I-Sesbania punicea yi-red sesbania ehlaselayo (isityalo sangaphandle esithatha indawo yezinye). Iipodi zayo zineempiko ezine ezihamba ubude. Qinisekisa ukuchongwa kwesityalo usebenzisa isikhokelo sezityalo esithembekileyo.

Khangela igama elipheleleyo phambi kokutyala. Hlonipha uluhlu lweentlobo zezityalo olwavunyelwene ngalo kwiprojekthi, kuquka nasiphi na isithintelo kwi-Sesbania sesban.

Sebenzisa indawo enelanga namanzi aphumayo kakuhle. Sisihlahla esixhasayo esiphila ixesha elifutshane; iqabaka nokuhlala kwamanzi emhlabeni kunokusithintela.

Gqiba ukuba isityalo ngasinye sibonelela kakhulu ngee-pea okanye ngamagqabi. Ukusika kakhulu nangokuphindaphindiweyo kunokusonzakalisa kwaye kunciphise isivuno sokutya.

I-cowpea igubungela izikhewu ezinelanga. I-pigeon pea ibonelela ngokutya nangamagqabi. I-Sesbania sesban elawulwayo inokubonelela ngenkxaso ende yethutyana.

Yongeza izityalo ezifanelekileyo ezidubulayo nezokugquma. Gcina isiqu se-mango sicocekile kwaye ulawule ukukhanya, amanzi nendlela yokufikelela.

Bala izixhaso ezinomthi kuzo zonke izikhewu eziphakathi kwemithi yeziqhamo. Hlwayela isigqubuthelo somhlaba esifanelekileyo ngokwendawo.

Akukho nani lilodwa elisebenza kuyo yonke imithi yeziqhamo. Hlengahlengisa ukuxinana ngokwamanzi, umhlaba, ubukhulu besityalo kunye namandla akho okunqunqa nokunciphisa.

problem: 'iba yafumaneka nini' is an ungrammatical tense mix; use 'ifumaneka nini'.
repaired: I-nitrogen ekwimpahla ye-legume esikiweyo ifumaneka nini kwezinye izityalo?

problem: 'umqukumbelo' means 'conclusion/summary', not 'ring' (use 'isangqa'); 'usama' is not a word (English: 'remains standing' = 'usemi'); 'Hambisa' (move/carry) should be 'Lungelelanisa' (match/adjust).
repaired:
Iklip ibonisa ukusikwa kwesebe: umthi ongumxhasi usemi. Shiya amagqabi anempilo anele ukuze isityalo siphinde sibuyele kwimeko.

Lungelelanisa ukusika nohlobo lwesityalo. Phepha ukusika kakhulu rhoqo kwi-pigeon pea, ingakumbi xa uyityala ukuze uvune ii-pea.

Ingca yokugquma ikhusela umphezulu, inceda ukugcina ukufuma kwaye ibuyisela impahla yezinto eziphilayo.

Shiya indlela yokufikelela ekunisweni nasekuhlolweni. Sika impahla ibe ziziqwenga ezilawulekayo uqhubeke ujonga ukufuma nokubola.

Fumana i-cultivar (uhlobo olukhethiweyo) echanekileyo. I-Bocking 14 ayisasazeki ngembewu ekwaziyo ukuhluma, kodwa iziqwenga zengcambu zinokuphinda zihlume.

Yibeke apho inendawo nokufuma okwaneleyo. Sika amagqabi njengoko ibuyela kwimeko; ungawuxinezeli umthi weziqhamo oselula.

Uninzi lwee-ladybird (iinambuzane ezincinci ezinamachokoza) ludla ii-aphid (iinambuzane ezincinci ezifunxa ijusi yezityalo); ezinye ii-parasitoid wasp (iinambuzane ezinjengeenyosi ezihlasela ezinye izinambuzane) zihlasela izinambuzane ezonakalisa izityalo. Izityalo ezidubulayo ezinjenge-African basil zinokongeza izixhobo.

Jonga ukuba zeziphi izinambuzane ezityelelayo nokuba umonakalo uyatshintsha na. Isityalo esidubulayo asiqinisekisi ulawulo lwezinambuzane ezonakalisayo.

I-Tulbaghia violacea inamagqabi amancinci amxinwa kunye neentyatyambo ezimfusa ezikhaphukhaphu (lilac). Beka iqela lezityalo apho linokukhanya nendawo yokukhula.

Jonga izinambuzane ezityelelayo. Ungathembisi ukuba isangqa se-wild garlic uza kugxotha izinambuzane ezonakalisayo okanye uphilise ukuqhambuka kwazo.

problem: 'usama' is not a word; English 'remains standing' = 'usemi'.
repaired: Isebe liyawa, ngoxa umthi ongumxhasi usemi. Oko kukunqunqa kunye ne-chop-and-drop (ukusika uyiyeke iwe emhlabeni).

problem: 'Imithi yeziqhamo evuthiweyo' reads as 'ripe(-fruit) trees'; English 'mature fruit trees' = 'ekhulileyo'. ('Its vines' has no antecedent in the English source either - source issue.)
repaired:
Dibanisa imisebenzi yenkxaso efunwa yindawo yakho: ukufaka i-nitrogen, ukutya, ingca yokugquma, iintyatyambo nesigqubuthelo somhlaba. Ezinye izityalo zenza imisebenzi emininzi.

Gcina indawo yesiqu nendlela ivuliwe. Phinda uhlole ilungu ngalinye njengoko i-mango kunye nabamelwane bayo bekhula.

Gcina iziqu zayo ezirhubuluzayo zikude nomthi weziqhamo oselula kwaye ugcine indlela yokuyinakekela. Iingcambu zayo nazo zisebenzisa amanzi nezondlo.

Apho izixhobo zinqongophele, qhathanisa isigqubuthelo esiphilayo nebheseni eqhelekileyo yengca yokugquma.

Tyala ngexesha elifanelekileyo, gquma ngengca uze ugcine amanzi okumisa isityalo. Gcina isikhewu sokufikelela sivuliwe.

Qala ngenani lezityalo ezixhasayo onokuzinakekela. Jonga ukusinda nokukhula phambi kokongeza ezinye.

Sika phantsi izixhasi ezikhethiweyo ezikhuphisanayo ukuze uvule indawo. Impahla esikiweyo efanelekileyo inokuhlala njengengca yokugquma: oku kukunciphisa nge-chop-and-drop.

Lawula ukuhluma kwakhona ukuze ugcine ivuliwe indawo. Hlola ukukhanya, ukufuma komhlaba nokukhula; ukunciphisa akuyeki ngoko nangoko ukhuphiswano lwengcambu.

Buyisela iinqunqo eziluncedo kwimithi esele imisiwe. Gcina izityalo ezikufutshane kuphela apho zisenza kakuhle.

Imithi yeziqhamo esele ikhulile isafuna izondlo. Jonga ukukhula, isivuno nemeko yomhlaba; izityalo ezixhasayo aziyisusi loo mfuno.

Hlola ukukhula komthi weziqhamo, umthunzi, ukufuma komhlaba, izivuno eziluncedo nomonakalo ngezinambuzane ezonakalisayo. Bhala oko kusikiweyo, kubuyiselwe okanye kususiwe.

Sebenzisa ezi ngqwalaselo ukutshintsha uyilo nenkathalo. Isityalo sifumana indawo yaso ngoko sikwenzayo apha.

problem: Drops 'whole' - the distinction between thinning (removing whole plants) and pruning (cutting branches) is the point of the key point.
repaired: Nciphisa izityalo ezixhasayo ezipheleleyo ezikhethiweyo xa ukunqunqa kungasanikezi ndawo yaneleyo.

problem: 'awusoze usebenzise manzi' = 'you will never use water'; English 'it never uses water' (sweet potato, class 1a: 'akasoze asebenzise'). Distractor stays wrong either way.
